source_live_overlay.recurrence_guard: Treat task-list query support as host-specific and retain one rejected-option witness without replaying a successful activation.

x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not combine archive-backed file reads and Git status in one short startup wrapper.

x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Keep archive-backed cleanliness separate from identity and metadata probes.

x1_operational.recovery: Use rg -n -- followed by the literal pattern and exact file; the bounded runner inspection then completed.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Insert the rg option terminator before any pattern that can begin with a hyphen.

x1_operational.recovery: Materialize receipt rows in an array, then pipe that array to the formatter; the six exact receipts parsed.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Materialize PowerShell foreach output before piping it.

x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Prefer a short materialized filter over nested one-line foreach and if blocks for title audits.

x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Use exact UTF-8 source context and split unrelated patches when a terminal display may have decoded Unicode differently.

x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Declare UTF-8 standard-stream encoding for Unicode-bearing evidence reports on Windows.
